methods.name: Exact BRC critical-degeneracy graph, asymptotic correction and root-selector calculus
capabilities: construct exact dominant edge weights, tie multiplicities and critical graph from explicit positive-rational branches
construct the non-negative integer critical-degeneracy matrix K
construct exact integer p_K(z)=det(I-zK)
select the smallest positive rational or irrational root using rational-root deflation and Sturm isolation
test the exact zero-correction structural law
compare critical log correction against rational LN thresholds by reusing finite-recurrent stability
produce existing rational BRC LN lower/upper expressions from an algebraic root interval
methods.core_law: For explicit positive-rational branch moment matrices, rho(W^(m))/mu^m -> rho(K); the exact subleading log state is Gamma_crit=-ln z_c with z_c the smallest positive root of det(I-zK).
methods.hard_boundary: Leading max-cycle asymptotics and general perturbation/root theory are classical. No floating eigensolver/root is an exact certificate; no general algebraic-log materializer, signed/amplitude extension, infinite-state extension or runtime-speedup claim is made. Aggregated total mass is not critical-degeneracy complete.

methods.name: Positive feedback-event condensation and interaction calculus
capabilities: exact event-level feedback condensation against a stable rational background
full updated stability and star through the feedback kernel
single-edge additive critical radius
conditional feedback kernel after an installed stable module
exact subset zeta factors for small declared event sets
all-orders rational Mobius interaction factors
first nonzero interaction order
Möbius-primitive directed circuit atoms with rational holonomy
methods.core_law: For stable background star S and inserted events e_r:a_r->b_r of mass delta_r, F_rs=S_bra_s*delta_s. Full update is stable iff F is stable and its new Gamma is Gamma(F). Conditional modules use Schur feedback kernels. Stable declared event sets have exact rational interactions J_T>=1; primitive supports are directed circuits with J_T=1/(1-Q_T).
methods.hard_boundary: Positive total-mass condensation only; subset/Mobius APIs are exponential in event count; no CWM count/provenance preservation, pairwise completeness, unique module credit, signed/amplitude, infinite-state, or runtime-speedup theorem.

methods.name: Finite recurrent positive Weighted-BRC rational gauge calculus
capabilities: exact finite non-negative rational transition-mass powers
exact recurrent total-mass stability decision without floating spectral materialization
exact rational Neumann star and canonical mass potential on the stable side
positive rational state-gauge normalization to row-subcritical form
pure integer stable-certificate verification after denominator clearing
pure integer divergence-certificate verification
one-state reduction to the existing S<1 recurrent law
methods.core_law: For finite W in M_n(Q_{>=0}), total all-depth mass is finite iff exists h>0 rational with Wh<h. Then W^star=(I-W)^-1 exactly and x=W^star 1 is the canonical potential. After W=A/D, stability iff exists positive integer h with Ah<Dh; otherwise a nonzero y>=0 exists with y^T A>=D y^T. A positive diagonal gauge localizes stability to row sums <1 and preserves closed-cycle products.
methods.hard_boundary: Finite non-negative rational total-mass projection only. No infinite-state theorem, signed/amplitude cancellation, complex recurrence, arbitrary-real exact-weight promise, probability/Markov semantics, or claim that dominant-path contraction alone implies total-mass stability.

methods.name: Exact integer-moment transition and length-marker port transfer
capabilities: construct exact W^(m) from explicit positive-rational branch edges
compute exact fixed-length path moment coefficient matrices
extract finite primitive moment signature W^0..W^R
evaluate exact rational resolvents at a rational length marker z
evaluate exact fixed-m port Schur kernel E_m(z)
compute exact equal-loop moment critical z
methods.core_law: For fixed integer m, W^(m) powers are exact path weight power-sums and E_m(z)=zB_m+z^2Y_m(I-zA_m)^-1X_m preserves original walk length at retained ports.
methods.hard_boundary: Constant W_eff is not length-safe; primitive finite moment cutoff is not automatically port-complete; rational evaluations outside positive stability are algebraic values rather than convergent recurrent mass sums.

methods.name: Exact non-split monic-quadratic Newton real/positive selectors
capabilities: construct exact quadratic selector state a,b,r,D,L,R
decide fixed declared multiplicity through R=Q(r)!=0
decide smallest-real selector stability without materializing quadratic roots
compute exact sign variation for the degree-two Sturm sequence
count distinct quadratic roots in the open interval (0,r) for declared r>0
decide smallest-positive selector stability by the open-interval Sturm observer
decide the equivalent compact radical-free smallest-positive chamber
expose exact chamber sign diagnostics and positive-formula consistency
evaluate rational-affine quadratic coefficient families at rational parameter points
verify the invariant L^2-D=4R
reuse: exact rational Sturm machinery as regression evidence only
methods.hard_boundary: One monic quadratic cofactor only. Smallest-real and smallest-positive are distinct observer semantics. The explicit degree-two Sturm variation/compact formulas are not a general parametric Sturm/subresultant solver, do not factor competing roots, and do not extend to higher degree without a new theorem.

methods.hard_boundary: Declared rational-root schedule validity is not global root-selector stability. The promoted constructibility result assumes rational-affine coefficient dependence and a finite declared schedule; this tool is not a generic CAD/decomposition engine, complete Puiseux solver, or multi-generator algebraic-field package.

Selector-value stability does not replace T59 declared multiplicity/schedule validity; smallest-real and smallest-positive semantics remain distinct.
